title: Generating uniform quantum state ensembles with continuous measurement
summary: We investigate the generation of uniform quantum state ensembles via continuous measurement. Using the $SU(d)$ Bloch representation, we derive the associated Langevin and Fokker-Planck equations and identify geometric conditions under which homogeneous monitoring causes global convergence to the uniform pure-state ensemble. We then extend the analysis to mixed states, showing that homogeneous purity-dependent decoherence rates generate uniform Hilbert-Schmidt and Bures ensembles of qubit states through an effective nonlinear stochastic evolution.
